name: GIWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: GIWF's top prize, changing hands four times across this record from a gold-belted Lonestar through to Desert Storm's ladder-match win at Wrestle Wrath.

name: GIWF United States Championship
epitaph: Crowned at the fed's own Turkey Day Titles PPV and defended in a steel cage before Steve Latini escaped ahead of Jacob McDonahey to take it in April 1996.

name: GIWF World Tag-Team Championship
epitaph: Won by Pressure Point in the fed's own inaugural Gold Rush tournament and held for a full year before the three-man Jingoist dethroned them at Wrestle Wrath.

name: GIWF Light-Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned at Turkey Day Titles and still in David "Death Sentence" Stevens's hands at Gold Rush II, the record's last dated card.

name: GIWF Women's Championship
epitaph: Crowned at Turkey Day Titles and still in Mean Man-Mama's hands at Gold Rush II, the record's last dated card.
